tasks.title: Database 8: Rust side of the compat harness
tasks.note: The new op vocabulary (object.new/call/get, adapter.call, the 8.x database.* ops) dispatched onto the Rust database, the old ops removed, per-case registry isolation, then the five shards (postgres, mysql, sqlite, mongo, redis) run locally.

tasks.title: Audit: the last compat difference
tasks.note: value::from_query turns any Row into a Document; PHP treats a non-Document cursor (Utopia\Audit\Log) as invalid and throws Exception\Query. Fixed with the compat harness.

tasks.title: Push the database 8 merge and get CI green
tasks.note: db8-final holds the whole port merged into feat/rust-utopia-conversion. Waits on the Rust compat harness; then the database lanes, migration, audit, usage and the Users parity diff run locally before one push. CI's database lanes and Users (Rust) stay red until then.

tasks.title: Rebuild the local PHP image
tasks.note: main moved packages/query and packages/migration after the appwrite image was built, so new PHP processes fail in init.php. Rebuilt once the agents using the containers finish.

tasks.title: Migration: port what packages/migration added after 3.1.2
tasks.note: Project environments, the passkey relying-party ID, passwordPwned and passwordRotation, membership IDs, topic QoS and expiry, and the reply-to and channelId options on messaging providers. The dev image still runs migration 3.1.2, so compat cannot check them yet.

tasks.title: Database filters that change the document (enum, range)
tasks.note: PHP 8.x's enum and range filters edit the attribute document; the Rust Filter trait gets it read-only, so both pass values through. Only user databases' attributes use them, and no Rust service reads those yet.
